title: Dequeue on an empty queue panics
prompt:
The job worker crashes when the queue is empty: `Dequeue` in queue/queue.go panics. Make `Dequeue` return
`(value, true)` or `(zero value, false)` when empty, keep FIFO order, and make sure dequeued items are not kept alive by
the underlying slice (memory grows in production): after many enqueue/dequeue cycles the backing array must not keep
growing without bound — reuse or compact it. Keep `Len`, and add an unexported `capacity() int` that returns the
capacity of the backing slice (the memory test reads it).
